title: Composed supervisory control: Safe restart after power or safety interruption -> Local/remote command latch

inputs.name: B_RemoteMode
inputs.description: Subsystem B: TRUE selects remote controls

outputs.name: A_RestartInhibit
outputs.description: Subsystem A: A fresh reset is required

outputs.name: B_SelectedStart
outputs.description: Subsystem B: Start selected by the current mode

scan.initialization: fresh function-block instance for every test case

assumptions: The function block is called exactly once per PLC scan.
Inputs are sampled at scan start and outputs are checked at scan end.
Each test starts from a fresh function-block instance.
Subsystem A executes before the supervisory latch and subsystem B within each scan.
Requirements inherited from subsystem B apply only while SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE.
When subsystem B is isolated, its externally visible outputs take their type-safe defaults.

requirements.text: Subsystem A shall satisfy: Loss of A_PowerOK or A_SafetyOK shall A_Stop A_Running and set A_RestartInhibit.
Subsystem A shall satisfy: A_Stop shall A_Stop A_Running without by itself setting A_RestartInhibit.
Subsystem A shall satisfy: A_Reset may clear A_RestartInhibit only when A_PowerOK and A_SafetyOK are TRUE and A_Start is FALSE.
requirements.property: G((A_Reset AND A_PowerOK AND A_SafetyOK AND !A_Start) -> !A_RestartInhibit)

requirements.text: Subsystem A shall satisfy: A_Running shall remain FALSE while A_RestartInhibit is TRUE.
Subsystem A shall satisfy: After A_Reset, a new A_Start may run the machine when A_PowerOK, A_SafetyOK, and not A_Stop hold.
requirements.property: G((A_Start AND !A_RestartInhibit AND A_PowerOK AND A_SafetyOK AND !A_Stop) -> A_Running)

requirements.text: While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: B_SelectedStart shall use B_RemoteStart in remote mode and B_LocalStart in local mode.
requirements.property: G(B_SelectedStart = ((B_RemoteMode AND B_RemoteStart) OR ((!B_RemoteMode) AND B_LocalStart)))

requirements.text: While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: B_Stop or loss of B_Permit shall force B_Running FALSE.
While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: The selected start shall latch B_Running only while B_Permit is TRUE and B_Stop is FALSE.
While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: A start from the non-selected mode shall have no effect.
A TRUE A_Running shall latch CrossReady unless CrossReset is TRUE in the same scan.
CrossReset shall have priority, clear CrossReady, and isolate every subsystem-B output to its type-safe default.
Once set, CrossReady shall remain TRUE after the subsystem-A signal falls, until a later CrossReset scan.
Subsystem B may execute only while SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE; CrossBlocked is TRUE exactly when SubsystemBEnable is requested without CrossReady.

provenance.origin: deterministic ordered composition of independently specified base behaviors
